title: say must not silently swallow unknown flags into message text
desc: DEFECT (verified, evidence: review #a5af03fe finding 5): bin/chatcode:1607-1608 appends unrecognized argv to say's text, so 'say hello --typee note' posts text 'hello --typee note' as type say — the flag the agent intended is lost with zero warning. Repro on current main: run that command against --local and read the JSONL line. ACCEPTANCE: (1) unknown flags to say cause a non-zero exit with a clear error (or at minimum an explicit stderr warning AND the flag kept out of the text — pick one, state the choice in the PR); (2) a one-command test proves old behavior vs new; (3) genuine message text starting with a dash must still be postable (document how); (4) no format changes (R10). NON-GOALS: touching other subcommands' arg handling.
